title: Deterministic synthetic plan lookup
description: Requires a single deterministic tool call and use of its synthetic result.
systemPrompt: For plan lookups, use the provided synthetic tool. Never infer a benefit code.

turns.user: Look up the plan for synthetic member SYNTH-100 and report the exact benefit code.

tools.name: lookup_synthetic_plan
tools.description: Returns a synthetic member plan fixture. This tool has no external effects.

memberId.description: The synthetic member identifier, for example SYNTH-100.

calls.text: The deterministic synthetic lookup reports benefit code EVAL-BASIC for member SYNTH-100.
